notes: Adductors and inner thighs still sore from first equestrian session (May 22) — not in readiness schema. Upper-body pull focus; no lower body work.

• Got dizzy/nauseated mid-session (no fever) — traced to being 3 days into switching antihistamines (Zyrtec→Xyzal), not a training or GI issue.
• Lower strength score jumped 435→536 despite low energy (1/5) — heavy lower body stacked on existing equestrian soreness.

Energy 5, felt great. Rope handle on Rotational Lift rests on lower knuckle (MCP joint) of both thumbs — went down in weight due to discomfort. Concern given bilateral hand surgery history. Consider alternative attachment for this movement.
First session using Polar H10 chest strap — Apple Watch left off due to D-Moose hooks on both wrists.
Knee strap worn (patellar tendon strap) — minimal relief, likely needs full sleeve per PT consult. Energy 5/5, best session yet on this program. No PRs flagged.

• New PRs across the board (Hip Thrust 110 lb, Kickback 27 lb, Hip Abduction 20 lb) despite a rough night — woke every 15 min with GI burping.
• Suspected partial-dose shots the prior 2 weeks (air in pen) — may have hit a full tirzepatide dose for the first time in a while, possibly explaining the strong performance.
• Ankle Strap adduction: dropped from 20→15 lb mid-set, too many reps at 20 — next time 5 reps/side.

• Manually pushed weight above Smart Flex's suggestions on all movements — PRs reflect combined SF + self-directed progression, not SF alone.
• All-time PRs: Glute Bridge 137 lb, SL Hamstring Curl 31 lb, bilateral Hamstring Curl 30 lb.

workout: Hands Free Lower Body + Core B
notes: Shot day (6.3mg tirzepatide). Hip thrust PRs on all 3 working sets — exceeded GF3 moderate target, beat GF1 PR of 110 lbs (new: 120 lbs). Prone bench hamstring curl: drop sets — started at 31 lbs, lowered to 27 then 25 for full ROM, working to failure. Standing leg extension: right knee pain even with brace, stopping before 80° — brace being returned. Returning the brace.

Hip flexion block not set to alternating — ended up doing 5 reps each side as a single set instead of 3×5 per side. Forgot banded lateral walk (rest block finisher not obvious). Standing bicycle: held on with one hand for balance while the other arm crunched — good movement to continue building.

Back-logged from screenshot (session wasn't captured at the time). Single-movement snack session — Barbell Hip Thrust only. New all-time PR: 146 lbs (up from 120 lbs on 6/18), flagged VOLUME PR in-app on the final set.

workout: Heavy Express — Floor Bridge + Ankle Straps
notes: Energy 2, vibes 3 — Zepbound titration side effects. Skipped the 4th movement in the session (workout listed 4 movements total) due to titration side effects; did the 3 logged. Titrating to 7.5mg dose Thursday. Glutes/hamstrings still recovering (50%) going into this session; new PRs on all 3 logged movements (glute bridge 143 lbs strength+volume, donkey kick 32 lbs strength, hamstring curl 33 lbs strength).

• First hands-on/upper-body session since the carpal tunnel/ulnar neuropathy diagnosis — surgeon cleared hands the day before, wrist-support gloves debuted.
• Trainer added a dead-bug-style anti-extension hold during Bench Press — noticeably harder than standard.

Energy 3, vibes 3. Two brand-new movements (Iso Split Squat Lift, Resisted DNS Star) — immediate PRs on first attempt, as expected for new movements. Performed Iso Split Squat Lift kneeling rather than the standard standing split-squat stance — knee-friendly modification.

• Stopped ~2/3 through — grip gave out on Barbell Single-Leg RDL, not pain (surgeon's stop criteria is pain, not fatigue).
• Programming lesson: leading the session with Single-Leg RDL was too aggressive for grip endurance at the time — save grip-plus-balance combos for later in a session.
• Low pre-workout carbs (~34g) and low energy/vibes (1/5) likely compounded.

sets.note: Had to break and regrip mid-set — left hand. No pain, no tingling; grip fatigue only, resolved.

notes: Energy 1, vibes 3, sweat dry. Low energy but good vibes — still notably better vibes than yesterday. PR (volume) on Standing Chop set 2. Had to break and regrip mid-set on Suitcase March (left hand) — no pain, no tingling, grip fatigue only, resolved immediately.
No hand issues today — about the right amount of hand-load work. Power PR on Goblet Squat to Bench, set 2 (6 reps @ 43 lbs).

Energy 4, vibes 4, sweat dry (both Tonal and Hydrow today). Power PR on Iso Split Squat Lift, set 3 (8 reps @ 12 lbs). Tonal then Hydrow back-to-back. Hydrow row afterward (15 min, first full-length piece): hands felt fine, but wrists got sore during/after — first time wrist specifically (not grip) has been the limiting factor. Possibly duration or stacking with Tonal same-day; not yet isolated.
Right leg felt weaker than left. Standing leg consistently felt like it was doing more work regardless of which side stood — matches known right hip stability imbalance.

First workout back after hysteroscopy on 2026-08-23 (14 days prior). Lots of walking during recovery. Pre-workout readiness 100% across the board. Full-body restart (Workout by Tia): Goblet Squat 32 lb, Seated Row 23-24 lb, RDL 39-40 lb, Bench Press ~19 lb/cable, plus mobility (Cat-Cow, Dead Bug, Bretzel, hamstring stretch). Energy 3, vibes 4, sweat dry. 64 working reps, 16.75 min. Post-readiness: glutes 54 / quads 65 / hamstrings 69 / back 74 the biggest drops.

• Best-feeling session of the return so far (energy 5, vibes 5), but Pallof Press showed a clear post-layoff regression (15 lb vs. a prior 24 lb PR).
• Deliberately avoided posterior chain — glutes still DOMS-stuck at 77 from the day before.

movements.name: Half Roll Down with Wide Row

notes:
• Guided class with light 5 lb resistance (not bodyweight-only as planned); hip/leg moves hit glutes/hamstrings harder than expected (71%/69% post).
• Incidental adductor work (untracked by Tonal) — inner-thigh soreness reported next day, consistent with the manual readiness estimate (~58%).
• Chest/shoulders correctly left untouched, still recovering from Monday's Upper A.

• Hip Thrust showed real detraining — dropped to 100 lb from a prior 136 lb working weight, climbed 100→110→115 across sets.
• Bar-stability fix: bracing arms on the bench instead of gripping the bar directly — more stable, wrist-friendly.
• Second session of the day (after Upper B) — zero muscle overlap confirmed by readiness.
• An 8-min Zoom call interrupted the rest period — near-fresh reattempts each set, not a standard-rest progression.

• Power PR Bent Over Row (24 lb); Volume PR Pallof Press (12 lb) — held reps/control even after dropping weight twice to protect form.
• Pallof Press form broke down on set 3 (leaning instead of staying upright) — correctly dropped weight rather than grind bad reps.
• Wrist accommodations (elbow bend on Chop, wider grip on Triceps Extension) — standard setup going forward.
• Hips/legs correctly left untouched to protect Tuesday's Pilates recovery.

• Did Tonal's AI-generated session instead of the planned off-Tonal circuit; very fragmented sleep (real sleep didn't start until ~4am), energy 1, vibes 3.
• Liked the active-rest pairing (Floor Slide during Biceps Curl rest) — want this pattern built into the Heavy Six customs going forward.
• More flat-palm time than usual (Plank Walk Out, wider Bear Hold) — watch for tingling/numbness as a data point.
• FS 310 (target 48-64) and MQ 263 (target 46-62) — well above target on both.

• Dead Bug set 1 cut short (2/8 reps) to reposition handles, not a strength issue — made up with 8 bonus reps during the rest after set 3.
• Suitcase March 40-42 lb, Farmer March 25-30 lb — real loaded carries. Skipped the planned Drive row after: grip was cooked from the carries, moved it to the next day.
• Substantial bodyweight work folded into rest periods (3×10 Glute Raises, 4×30s Wall Sits, 10 Bodyweight Squats, 10 Single-Leg Glute Raises) — not in the Tonal movements list since it's off-Tonal.
• Two real limiters: grip (from the carries) and Bench Press, which hit true failure at 24-25 lb and dropped to 22 lb to finish. Bench reps logged as 4/set are 2/side alternating, not 4 total.

• Second session of the day, evening Quick Fit after rain cancelled the walk — wanted to move.
• Triceps Kickback started at 6 lb, dropped to 5 — triceps were the hardest part by far, matching the biggest readiness drop (100→57%).
• Felt real relief in the lower back when engaging the core during the seated sets — likely counteracting some of the morning's back fatigue.

• Resisted Step Up hurt the knee (side/lateral loading) — swapped live to bodyweight Front Step Up, 10/side × 3, both hands on frame for balance only. Front step-ups are knee-safe.
• Glute Bridge set 3: failed 150 and 141 lb before landing the real ceiling at 140 — rep 5 close to failure.
• First loaded Lateral Bridge with Row — Strength+Power PR (16 lb), Power PR (19 lb).

• First drop sets since early in the year — re-tried them and liked them again; realized heavier starting weight — more pre-fatigue for the drop.
• Struggled hard enough on one rep that Tonal's auto-unload kicked in and cut resistance to zero — genuine failure, not a glitch.
• Bench Press and Standing Face Pull drops both ran long (20 and 18 reps on the drop) — ~59 total reps across the session by feel.
• Drop sets are back in rotation going forward — confirmed she likes them again.

• Illness-adjacent day (called in sick, worsening fatigue, ear pain, sore throat) — skipped planned Hip Thrust drop sets, did this gentle Recovery Mode session instead once feeling improved.
• First time using Tonal's Recovery Mode (80% of suggested weight) — really liked it as a low-energy-day option: real training stimulus without pushing through depletion. Likely go-to for future low-energy days.
• Worked out useful form adjustments on Single-Arm Deadlift during this session.
• Standing Overhead Press dropped 9→6 lb on set 2 — self-regulated down given energy 1/5.
• Unusually high cardio response for the load (HR 113 avg, 10.9/19.1 min in Z2) despite coach-led slow/mindful tempo — slow pacing should've kept HR lower, not higher, so likely illness-driven rather than workout-structure-driven.
• Both knees felt weary/sore on bending (not sharp, not the usual right-knee pattern) — reduced squat depth on Single-Arm Squat with Row, stopped before provoking real pain. Bilateral + dull quality reads as general illness-related joint achiness, distinct from the tracked mechanical right-knee issue.

• Wrist/elbow/arm soreness today — picked low-grip movements.
• 3-block circuit (Hip Thrust+Curl+Lunge), built via API.
• App preview showed only Hip Thrust, looked broken — deleted a working hand-edited version by mistake (lost). Confirmed after: preview was wrong, circuit ran fine.
• Glutes hammered 99%→12% from the drop set.
• Vibes 3 = frustration with the saga, not the training.
• Reverse Lunge hurt knees even unweighted — was safe in May. Stopped short of full depth. Maybe tied to the 10/14 knee weariness, still unresolved.
• Curls kept light on purpose to save energy for Hip Thrust.

• First session of "20-in-20: Spiced-Up Sets" (pre-fatigue structure).
• Block 1: real early failure. Bench Press 6→3→4 reps, cut 22→18 lb.
• Block 2 (rows) held up fine, full reps.
• Glutes and quads protected, saved for tomorrow.
• PRs: Strength PR (Rotational Row set 2), Volume PR (Rotational Row set 3), 1RM increase (Seated Row set 1, 26lb).

• Mini Sumo Squat: volume + strength PR on set 3 (36lb x14)
• RDL: power PR set 1, strength+power PR set 2, power+volume PR set 3 (dual-cable, 86-90lb)
• Glutes took the biggest hit (51% → 0% post) - real work on the main PR movements
• Energy 5, rating 5 - strong session all around

• Sprinter Crunch (programmed) caused pressure, not stretch, on lower back - swapped to Pilates rollups, felt great, no back issue
• Same lower-back region loaded by compensatory rowing mechanics the night before (slide-shooting); spot has been touch-sensitive ~30 years, predating today
• Overhead Triceps Extension hit genuine failure on set 2 (28lb), dropped to 26lb set 3 - real max-effort test, not Smart Flex inflating the number
• Needed breaks mid-set on Resisted Dead Bug sets 2-3 (core fatigue) but still landed higher reps (8→11→10)

• Second workout of the day (Workout 2 of The Functional 5) - felt wonderful
• Upper body: overhead press, dead bug, v-up, bench press
• Strength PR on Half Kneeling Overhead Press (10lb, true working set after warmup)
• Bench Press: 1RM increase set 1 (17.5lb), power PRs sets 2-3 (18.5lb)
• Strength Sets now at 20 for the week, within the 16-22 target range
• Caught and fixed a real fetch-sessions.ts bug today: this session initially inherited Workout 1's movements due to a date+name matching collision, not its own bench/overhead press data

• First workout of The Functional 5, switched from Spiced-Up Sets after its timed-set injury mechanism
• Real rep-based RDL within a 30sec/6-rep window, not open-ended timed
• Found a trick: starting reps before the on-screen timer officially begins gives real buffer - hit 7 reps on set 1
• Done at FULL load despite Athlytic 28% recovery and low glute/hamstring pre-readiness (45%/63%) - no moderation, went full effort, felt great, no pain
• Post-readiness showed genuine full fatigue (glutes to 0, hamstrings to 12) - real work, not watered down
• Real lesson: tempo control was the fix, not load reduction - same as the rowing slide-shooting fix
